2119465694110822718.en_summary: @garyblack00 says he has seen $TSLA repeatedly make marketing decisions without basic consumer research, with Cybertruck as the latest example, and that passenger statistics should not be conflated with actual ride demand.

2119463708099547346.en_summary: $OTIS CEO: China's property reforms are ending developers' reliance on customer deposits to fund construction. For any presales, for the first time in 2 decades, those down payments have to go to escrow, so they can't be used to finance the next project.
2119463708099547346.zh_summary: $OTIS 行政總裁：中國房地產改革正在結束開發商依賴客戶訂金資助建設的做法。對於任何預售，二十年來首次，那些首付款必須存入託管帳戶，因此不能用於資助下一個項目。

2119458038260318634.en_summary: @aleabitoreddit shares various commentary from Qualcomm, Arm, to Meta executives during the AI selloff, including $LITE CEO noting massive disconnect between demand books and market selloff, $AMD CEO saying demand higher than supply and beginning of adoption cycle, $ARM CEO on global demand and US competition with China, $APLD on robust demand despite financing risks, $QCOM on supply-bound not demand-bound, and $META on political risks but cooperation. TLDR: extremely bullish from accelerator, networking, and semi companies; no evidence of AI demand destruction.
2119458038260318634.zh_summary: @aleabitoreddit 分享 AI 拋售期間來自高通、Arm 至 Meta 高管的各種評論，包括 $LITE 行政總裁指出需求帳與市場拋售之間存在巨大脫節，$AMD 行政總裁表示需求高於供應且處於採用週期初期，$ARM 行政總裁談全球需求及美國與中國的競爭，$APLD 稱需求極為強勁儘管有融資風險，$QCOM 指是供應受限而非需求受限，以及 $META 談政治風險但有合作。總結：加速器、網絡和半導體公司極為看多；未見 AI 需求破壞的證據。
